study type: Post-hoc analysis of a cluster-randomized controlled trial
exposure: Massive transfusion (RBCs ≥ 8 units within 6h or ≥ 20 units within 24h)
Adherence to balanced transfusion (FFP to RBC ratio >0.5, PC to RBC ratio >0.5)
outcome: Adherence to balanced transfusion based on FFP to RBC ratio
Adherence to balanced transfusion based on PC to RBC ratio
cohort: The study included 220 severely injured patients from the RESTRIC trial in Japan who received transfusions.
finding: The adherence to balanced transfusion in terms of FFP to RBC ratio was nearly 100%, but the adherence for PC to RBC ratio was not fully balanced, especially in the early phase (51.0% for group 1 and 68.4% for group 2 within 6 hours).
